procedure_name: Vehicle No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Inter-State Transfer
summary: NOC required under Form 28 to re-register a vehicle in another state or union territory.

steps.title: Pencil chassis print on Form 28
steps.description: Take clear physical pencil impression of vehicle's metallic chassis number on 3 copies of Form 28.

steps.title: Check traffic challan and hypothecation
steps.description: Clear all pending electronic traffic challans and obtain bank loan closure NOC if previously financed.

steps.title: Apply online on Vahan portal
steps.description: Submit destination state and destination RTO jurisdiction code where vehicle will be moved.

steps.title: Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) verification
steps.description: RTO checks national stolen vehicle database to ensure vehicle is not subject to police alert.

steps.title: Collect Form 28 NOC certificate
steps.description: Obtain official stamped NOC certificate valid for re-registration in destination state.
